column4: Hector Appuhamy Helping Hand Charity
Foundation  (Incorporation)
The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column3: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column4: to  provide  medical  aid  and  food  to  the  poor,  the
destitute and the sick;
to conduct special services for needy school children
and to offer assistance by way of scholarships, library
facilities  and  other  necessary  educational  support
for students;
to conduct classes for the students sitting for year
five  scholarship,  GCE  (O/L)  and  GCE  (A/L)
examinations  by  experts  in  the  particular  field  of
education;
to support and encourage the services provided by
senior citizens’ organizations;
to  develop  pre-schools  for  early  childhood
development of the needy children;
to give aid by way of scholarships to any officer or
servants engaged in the furtherance of the objects
of the Corporation;
to  promote  understanding,  co-operation  and
friendship  with  similar  institutions  within  and
outside Sri Lanka;
to organize employees of small and medium scale
industries  and  enterprise  services  and  working
towards their future advancement;
to initiate and implement economic, social, cultural
and  environmental  development  activities  in
Sri Lanka and providing guidance necessary for it;
to  combat  waste  and  corruption  and  utilize  all
resources  belonging  to  our  community  in  a  very
useful manner;
